ActivityDocumentPage.description: A page of the live board.

head.description: The log position this reflects, which a stream can follow from with `after`. -1 is before the first event.

day.description: Whole days since the epoch, in UTC.

AuditCheckDto.description: One sampled claim and what was found about it. A finding is one of these whose outcome isn't `passed`.

changeset_id.description: The review item a person decides this on.

detail.description: May hold a document's or a model's words, so show it as plain text.

sample.description: The claims it sampled, in rank order. The checks route has what was found about each.

revoked.description: Combinations this run took auto-commit from.

siblings_remaining.description: Claims of revoked combinations still to go back to review. Later runs carry on with them.

state.description: `queued`, `running`, `finished`, or `failed` if its job gave up.

stop.description: Why its LLM checks ended early: `run_budget`, `day_budget`, `llm_unavailable` or `llm_refused`. Running out of budget isn't a failure.
Why its LLM checks stopped short, in a word.

AuditScheduleBody.description: How often to audit, how much, and what it may spend.

ttl_days.description: Days until claims of each predicate go stale.

total_missed_slots.description: Slots passed over since it began, because the server was away or a run was still open.

correct.description: Since it was last disabled. These decide whether it's on.

history.description: When it was earned, fell below the threshold or was disabled, oldest first.

block_id.description: The block holding the link, which is its evidence.

via_slug.description: The slug as the link wrote it, which may be an old one.

BatchResultDto.description: How one decision went. One failing leaves the others as they are.

error_code.description: Set when it failed, with the same codes as the single routes.

CacheTierDto.description: One cache tier's counters since the server started.

cap_bytes.description: The tier's limit. 0 means it's off.

corrupt.description: Disk files that couldn't be trusted, each also counted as a miss.

rejected.description: Entries too big for the tier to keep.

matched_on.description: The identity field or `$alias` the mention matches exactly. Absent on a keyword match.

score.description: The keyword score, comparable only within this answer.

extractor.description: The model behind an extraction, or otherwise whoever proposed it. Absent from before spec 025.

original_ops.description: What was proposed, when a person changed it before approving. `ops` then holds what was approved.

CitationDto.description: Where an item's text comes from. `anchor` is always there: `located`, `broken` or `none`.

speaker.description: Who was speaking, when that's known and one person spoke all of it.

t_start_ms.description: Where it plays in the original recording, in milliseconds. Only a recording has these.

items.description: The results as validated, each with its segment and exact quote.

outcome.description: `done`, or `failed` when the tokens were spent with nothing usable back.

DocumentActivityDto.description: One document on the live board.

job_id.description: The job this depends on now, if one does.

partial.description: Some part of it didn't work, whatever stage it's in now.

DocumentProgressDto.description: How far a worker has got.

DurableFrame.description: One event from the log, reduced to what can safely be said about it. Its `seq` is the frame's SSE id.

counts.description: How many rows of each kind the event wrote.

kind.description: The event's kind, or `other` for one this server doesn't list.

omitted.description: How many items didn't fit in the lists above.

ops.description: What to approve instead of what was proposed, which stays on record.

EndFrame.description: The last frame of a stream, and why.

reason.description: `auth_ended` (the token or session is over), `scope_lost` (it can't read this vault now), `vault_gone`, `unverifiable` (the store was away too long to check), `unavailable` or `server_stopping`.

redirected_from.description: The id asked for, when it has been merged into this one.

EntityDto.description: An entity's current state, as lists show it.

conflicted_fields.description: The fields with a claim that disagrees with the current value.

aliases.description: Replaces the aliases. Leave it out to keep them.

EntityFieldDto.description: A field: its current value, why it's the one, and every other claim. `conflicts` lists those that disagree, and `agreeing` those that don't.

EntityProposalResult.description: A proposal about an entity, and the entity it's about.

changeset_id.description: The ChangeSet that made it, absent on a seed type's built-in first version.

schema.description: The version's JSON Schema, with the annotations `searchable`, `filterable` and `identity` on its fields.

code.description: A stable machine-readable code, such as `not_found`.

current.description: On `stale_version`: the row as it is now, so the caller can rebase.

quote.description: Verbatim from the segment, apart from runs of whitespace.

page_id.description: The wiki page a page or block item belongs to.

broken.description: The quote no longer resolves. Reported rather than guessed.

media_type.description: The source's media type. A recording's bytes play from `/sources/{sid}/stream`.

rects.description: Displayed coordinates in 1/100 pt, one per line.

speaker.description: Who was speaking, when that's known and one person spoke all of it.

superseded.description: A newer rendition exists. This still resolves.

t_start_ms.description: Where the quote plays in the original recording, in milliseconds. Only a recording has these.

EvidencePackageDto.description: The answer to a search: claims first, then segments, then context sections, within a token budget.

degraded.description: Signals that couldn't answer, so the result rests on the others.

low_relevance.description: Nothing here looks like an answer.

stop.description: `budget`, `failed_batches` or `superseded`, when a run ended short.

proposed.description: New proposals this run made, which wait in the review queue.

rejected.description: Results refused, such as a quote that isn't in its segment.

rendition_id.description: The current rendition, once there is one.

FacetsDto.description: Counts over the candidates found, not the whole vault.

FieldClaimDto.description: A claim on a field. Every value traces to one, and a person's claim may have no evidence.

FieldEvidenceDto.description: One piece of evidence, and the way to its source. `assertions/{assertion_id}/lineage` and `.../evidence/{evidence_id}/highlight` give the full region.

anchor_broken.description: Re-anchoring on a new rendition failed.

FieldInputDto.description: One proposed value. It's added beside any others on the field, unless it says which claim it replaces.

HeartbeatFrame.description: Says the stream is alive when nothing else has.

HelloFrame.description: The first frame of every stream.

head.description: Where the log's reader was as this stream opened. -1 is before the first event.

resumed.description: Whether this stream carries on from a position the client named.

t_start_ms.description: A recording's highlight is a time range and has no page or rects.

waiting_since_ms.description: Set while the job waits for something that's away, such as the LLM.

JobFact.description: A job at one moment. Its error messages, its input and who holds it stay out, as an error can quote a document.

docs.description: How many objects an embedding job holds.

stage.description: The stage this job's work belongs to, when it's about a document.

needs_llm.description: Only an LLM check can catch this kind.

watermark.description: The last event this answer reflects, absent before the first.

proposer.description: Who proposed it, and whether a machine did.

LoginBody.description: Signs in a browser. No `Debug`, so the token can't reach a log by accident.

coarse_spans.description: Stretches read with less accurate times, because the transcriber crashed on them once.

duration_ms.description: Empty until transcribed, as decoding is what finds it.

gaps.description: Holes in the audio, kept as silence so times stay on the original timeline.

skipped_spans.description: Stretches the transcriber crashed on twice, which have no words.

MeetingBody.description: A full replacement of a meeting's metadata, as a proposal.

title.description: With no title set, the file's name.

version.description: The version to base an edit on.

direction.description: `out` when the object asked about is where the link starts, or `in`.

neighbor.description: What's at the other end. Null is a link to a slug no page holds.

title.description: The other end's title, when it's a page.

base_version.description: The version this builds on, as the type list gave it. Leave it out for a new type.

slug.description: Left out, it's made from the title.

principal_id.description: Whose token it is. The default is the caller.

target.description: The slug or claim id as written.

PageClaimDto.description: What a page's `{{claim:<id>}}` shows now, whichever revision of the page is being read.

current_claim_id.description: The claim that stands now: the one named, or what replaced it. Absent when missing.

body.description: Canonical Markdown: exactly its blocks, joined.

current_revision.description: The version an edit bases itself on.

restored_from.description: The revision this one restored, on a revert.

slug.description: The slug at the revision shown.

title.description: Old and new, if it changed.

base_version.description: The version this edit was made from. If the page has moved on, the answer is a conflict with its current state.
Needed to edit the page already holding its slug.

markdown.description: A page as export gives it: front matter with a JSON-quoted `title`, and optionally `slug` and `redirects`, then the Markdown. Without front matter, its first heading is the title.

created.description: False when it edited an existing page.

redirected.description: The slug asked for is an old one.

slug.description: Left out, it's made from the title. The old slug keeps leading here.

revision.description: The revision to make current again, as a new revision.

redirects.description: Old slugs, oldest first, that still lead here.

version.description: The version an edit bases itself on, which is also the newest revision.

entity_id.description: The Person a committed proposal links them to.

id.description: Stable, so a link can follow them. The server gives one to a participant sent without it.

speaker.description: A transcript's label for them, when someone knows it.

id.description: Leave out for a new participant.

ParticipantLinkBody.description: Proposes that a participant is this Person.

kinds.description: Kinds to plant, and every kind if left out.

ProgressFrame.description: What a worker last said about a job. In memory only, so it has no id and no resume.

verdict.description: Absent for items with no verdict yet.

pending.description: Pending items. One with several types counts once here, and once under each in `groups`.

RecallReportDto.description: What planted errors in this vault came to. Keep the two groups apart: the deterministic one is measured, and the LLM one means something only when `llm_evidence` is `model`.

llm_evidence.description: `none`, `scripted` or `model`. Scripted answers prove the mechanism and say nothing about a model.

target_met.description: Null until it can be judged: every kind planted, with answers from a real model.

too_small.description: Too few planted errors to trust the figure.

chain.description: The ids passed on the way there, the asked one first.

current_id.description: The entity this id leads to now, which is itself unless it has been merged.

word_table.description: The word table and page facts. Absent for plain text.

pages.description: How each page was read: `route`, mean OCR confidence in permille, and `flags`.

version.description: The claim's version when it was read.

candidates.description: Exact matches first. Choosing among them is the caller's decision.

degraded.description: `lexical`, if only exact matches could be looked for.

ResyncFrame.description: Fetch a new snapshot, then carry on from here. Also the frame's SSE id.

head.description: The position this stream continues from. -1 is before the first event.

auto_commit_block.description: Why auto-commit wouldn't take this even if earned.

combinations.description: Each type's standing under this proposal's extractor and prompt. A type with no samples has no entry.

needs_a_person.description: Only a person can approve this.

page_flags.description: What the pipeline flagged on these pages, such as hidden text.

superseded.description: Its document was processed again, so this can't be approved as it stands.

ReviewVerdictDto.description: The reviewer agent's opinion. It's advice, and it decides nothing.

reason.description: The model's own words about untrusted text, so show them as plain text.

SameAsDto.description: A suggestion, never a decision: these entities share an identity value or alias. Merging them is a proposal, which a person approves.

t_start_ms.description: Where it plays, when it comes from a recording.

version.description: What optimistic edits base themselves on.

aliases.description: The aliases that move to the new entity.

fields.description: Anything else the new entity needs to be valid, such as its own name.

moved.description: The active claims that move to the new entity.

TokenDto.description: A token's details. The token itself and its hash never appear here.

TranscriptPartDto.description: A stretch of a transcript: a turn, cut to the window asked for. Its range is the same a claim citing these words gets.

speaker.description: Who was speaking, when that's known and one person spoke all of it.

start.description: UTF-8 byte offsets into the rendition's canonical text.

start_ms.description: The table's own times, with no padding.

TriggerAuditBody.description: What to run. Anything left out comes from the schedule. The same seed on the same state gives the same sample.

seed.description: A decimal number, as text, since it can be too large for a JSON number to carry safely.

TypePreviewDto.description: What submitting this schema would do for this caller. Nothing is written.

problem.description: Why a submission would be refused. Absent if it's acceptable.

target.description: The slug or claim id that leads nowhere.

existing.description: These bytes were already here, so nothing new was created.

204.description: Signed out, or there was no session

201.description: Signed in. The session is in an HttpOnly cookie.

get.summary: Follows everything happening in a vault as server-sent events. Frames are named `hello`, `durable`, `progress`, `resync`, `heartbeat` and `end`. `durable` and `resync` frames have ids, and a stream resumes after one with `Last-Event-ID` or `after`. A `resync` frame means fetch a new snapshot from `/activity/documents` and carry on. Frames hold ids, kinds, stages, counts and timings, and never document text.
The live board: each document's stage and status, in id order. `head` is the log position this reflects, to follow the stream from.

parameters.name: seq

post.summary: Corrupts claims in a test vault and tags them, tagging what's left clean, to measure what audits catch. It's refused on any other vault.

get.summary: What planted errors came to, per kind and in two groups: kinds the deterministic checks catch, and kinds only LLM checks can. Scripted answers say nothing about a model, so `target_met` stays null until a real model's run.
Runs in creation order, with their seeds, what each found and what it spent.

post.summary: Starts a run now. A seed makes it repeatable: the same seed on the same state samples the same claims as any other run with that seed, scheduled or not. It may spend tokens, so it needs admin scope.

get.summary: One run, with its seed and its sample in rank order.
What was found about each sampled claim, in rank order, with each check's result and the review item it led to. `findings=true` leaves out what passed.

put.summary: Replaces the schedule, which is off until someone turns it on. The first run comes one interval from now.

post.summary: Marks an empty vault as one errors can be planted in. It can't be undone.
